About you - 4+ years PQE, with a strong, hands-on in-house background within a bank or other regulated financial services business (a superannuation fund would also be a great fit) - Working knowledge of financial services legal work, such as derivatives and trading documentation, lending and finance, regulatory and compliance matters, or financial services commercial contracts - Ideally trained or practised at a top law firm - A passion for leveraging technology to transform legal services Legora is an Equal Opportunit

... accounting policies for key areas, including revenue (ASC 606: contract modifications, credits and concessions, multi-element SaaS arrangements), leases (ASC 842, including incremental borrowing rate), stock-based compensation (ASC 718) and income taxes support (ASC 740) with our tax team. - Support business combination accounting (ASC 805): purchase price allocation, valuation coordination with third-party specialists, and post-acquisition integration of acquired entities. - Advise on intercompany and transfer pricing mechanics, foreign currency (ASC 830) and the accounting for new entities as we enter new markets. - Monitor new and emerging standards and assess their impact on Legora. - Act as a primary point of contact for our external auditors on your areas: prepare support, answer technical questions and resolve findings. - Manage and review the work of external technical accounting and valuation advisors, keeping deliverables on time and in scope. - Design and document controls over technical accounting areas and non-routine transactions, in partnership with internal audit. WHAT YOU BRING - 7+ years of accounting experience, starting in Big 4, with a few years in a technical accounting or financial reporting role in industry. - CPA or an equivalent qualification. - Deep, current US GAAP knowledge, especially ASC 606, 842, 718 and 805, and a track record of writing memos that auditors accept. - Hands-on experience with PCAOB-standard audits and SOX or ICFR controls over technical areas. - Experience in a multi-entity, multi-currency group, including consolidation and intercompany. - Clear writing and the judgment to explain a complex position simply to auditors, executives and non-finance partners. - Comfort working with ambiguity in a fast-scaling company, and the drive to build processes from scratch.
